🔹 **The edge:**  
My approach blends hands-on industry knowledge with real operational strategy. Having worked inside practices myself, I understand both the front desk realities and backend complexities—allowing me to design solutions that *actually work* in the aesthetic space.

🔹 **Real results:**

As Founder & CEO of **New Era Intel**, I help medical spas, dermatology clinics, and plastic surgery practices grow smarter—not just louder.

With **over 10 years in the aesthetic industry** and **15+ years in marketing**, I’ve seen firsthand what actually moves the needle for clinics: it’s not just branding or ads—it’s streamlined systems, consistent client journeys, and automation that actually works.

💡 **My journey started in 2009** at Advanced Dermatology, where I wore every hat—from front desk and billing to cosmetic sales and marketing. I saw the same frustrating pattern: packed one month, empty the next. Even after boosting elective bookings by 22%, patients weren’t coming back.

After 8+ years improving operations and reducing claim rejections by 35%, I moved into broader marketing—growing wellness brands' social followings by 300%, increasing qualified leads by 65%, and slashing follow-up time by 60% through automation.

🎯 The real breakthrough? At Absolute AV Consulting, I implemented a CRM that cut the sales cycle by 40% and reduced lead loss by 70%. That’s when it clicked: the problem isn’t just marketing or operations—it’s **disconnected systems.**

That same problem exists in MedSpas today:
> Wasted ad spend. Unanswered leads. Underbooked injectors. Patients ghosting after one visit.

That’s why I created the **Fully Booked CRM™**—a done-for-you system that guarantees **15+ pre-qualified consults per month**, complete with:
- AI-powered follow-up (even at 2AM)
- Automated booking agents
- Meta ad campaigns that convert
- Funnel and website optimizations that work in the real world

📌 **But here’s what sets me apart:**  
I’m **not a marketing agency.**  
I run a **growth consultancy.**  
That means no cookie-cutter software or salesy service packages. I go into the practice, assess what’s broken, and **build a custom strategy** based on what you actually need.

🚀 My promise: If we don’t deliver at least 15+ consults in 30 days, I work for free until we do.

Tired of the feast-or-famine cycle?  
DM me **“FULLY BOOKED”** and let’s chat.

---
